examine.name: Examine
examine.description: Look closely at the object to learn more about it.

take.name: Take
take.description: Pick up the object and add it to your inventory.

attack.name: Attack
attack.description: Attempt to damage or destroy the object.

talk.name: Talk
talk.description: Attempt to communicate with the object or character.

open.name: Open
open.description: Try to open the object if it can be opened.

close.name: Close
close.description: Try to close the object if it can be closed.

push.name: Push
push.description: Try to move or push the object.

trade.name: Trade
trade.description: Buy or sell items with a merchant.

browse.name: Browse
browse.description: Look through available items or goods.

enter.name: Enter
enter.description: Enter or go inside the object if possible.
